question_this_text_answers: How does blocking a necessary input prevent a downstream process?

paragraphs.text: Closing the inlet valve cuts off the pump's water supply. Without that supply, the pump cannot deliver water to the upper tank, so the tank stops filling.

question_this_text_answers: What limits the generalizability of the findings?

paragraphs.text: We tested one pump at a single site. The small sample limits how confidently these findings can be generalized to other water systems.
